query: I have an innovative project idea for an interdisciplinary project in digital tech preservation of cultural heritage, with digital twining and predictive maintenance of heritage sites, with participatory research. Are there any upcoming calls in any HE strands? What is the budget, deadline, key parameters? Furthermore: Tell me of similar projects done in H2020/HE with project titles, call IDs, budgets, coordinator names, and list of partners.
response:
Your project idea, combining digital twinning, predictive maintenance, and participatory research for cultural heritage, sits at the critical intersection of **Cluster 2 (Culture, Creativity & Inclusive Society)** and **Cluster 4 (Digital, Industry & Space)**. This interdisciplinary focus significantly increases your funding opportunities. 

Here is an overview of upcoming funding possibilities and examples of similar funded projects to benchmark against.

***

## Part 1: Upcoming Horizon Europe Funding Opportunities

Direct opportunities typically fall under Cluster 2's 'Cultural Heritage' destination, often involving technologies from Cluster 4. The following general call openings and expected topics are relevant for 2025/2026.

### 1. Primary Cluster Calls (Cluster 2 and Cluster 4)

| Cluster/Call ID Pattern | Focus Area | Action Type | Typical Budget (RIA) | Indicative Deadline | Key Parameters (RIA) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Cluster 2 (HORIZON-CL2-2025/2026-HERITAGE-*)** | Digital Heritage, tangible/intangible preservation, participatory governance, European identity, cultural transformation. Your project aligns well here. | RIA/CSA | €3 - 8 million | Q1 2026 (Expected) | **Consortium**: Min 3 from 3 EU/AC countries. **Funding Rate**: 100%. | 
| **Cluster 4 (HORIZON-CL4-2025/2026-DIGITAL-*)** | Digital Twin technologies, AI for industrial and societal data spaces, advanced computing, immersive technologies (AR/VR). | RIA/IA | €4 - 10 million | Q4 2025/Q1 2026 (Expected) | **Consortium**: Min 3 from 3 EU/AC countries. **Funding Rate**: 100% (RIA) / 70% (IA). |

**Note on Specific Topics**: Specific topic calls for the 2025/2026 Work Programmes (e.g., dedicated topics on Digital Twins for Cultural Heritage) have not fully opened or been detailed on the portal yet. Please monitor the **HORIZON-CL2-2026-HERITAGE-01** and **HORIZON-CL4-2026-DIGITAL-01** call openings for the latest topic descriptions.

### 2. Cross-Cutting Funding Options

Your project is also highly competitive for thematic-neutral funding schemes:

*   **Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA-PF)**: Ideal if your project requires bringing in a postdoctoral researcher (of any nationality) to an EU/AC host institution for 1-2 years. MSCA-PF provides approximately €200k-€300k per fellow. (*Deadline typically September each year*).
*   **European Research Council (ERC) Grants**: If you, as the Principal Investigator (PI), have an excellent, high-risk/high-gain research track record and the project is purely frontier research (TRL 1-2). Grants range from **€1.5M (Starting)** to **€2.5M (Advanced)** over five years.

***

## Part 2: Similar Funded Projects (Benchmarking)

To guide your proposal writing, the following projects from Horizon Europe (HE) and Horizon 2020 (H2020) demonstrate successful funding in digital cultural heritage, digital twinning, and participatory research. They are excellent examples for identifying potential partners and methodologies.

### Core Projects (Digital Twin & Monitoring)

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Non-destructive, scalable, smart monitoring of remote cultural treasures (ARGUS)** (101132308) | **HORIZON-CL2-2023-HERITAGE-01-01** | ATHINA-EREVNITIKO KENTRO KAINOTOMIAS (EL) | **€3.99 Million** | EL, DE, IT, ES, CY, CH |
| 2 | **Inception** (665220) | H2020-SC6-2015-1 | PIN SOC.CONS. A R.L. (IT) | **€3.96 Million** | IT, ES, PT, PL, UK, SI, GR, BE, DE, FR |
| 3 | **AI4CH** (101004590) | HORIZON-CL2-2021-HERITAGE-01-02 | EURECOM (FR) | **€7.52 Million** | FR, CY, EL, IT, ES, NL, NO |

### Related Projects (Community & Digitisation Focus)

| # | Project Title (Acronym) / ID | Call ID | Coordinator (Country) | EC Contribution | Countries Involved |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | **Community-driven Digitisation for Heritage at Risk (Cordhisk)** (101149833) | HORIZON-MSCA-2023-PF-01-01 (MSCA) | TECHNISCHE UNIVERSITEIT DELFT (NL) | **€0.19 Million** | NL, UK |
| 5 | **ARIADNEplus** (823914) | H2020-INFRAIA-2018-2020 | PIN SOC.CONS. A R.L. (IT) | **€9.99 Million** | IT, UK, GR, FR, DE, AT, PL, ES, CY, PT... (28 Partners) |
| 6 | **DIGICULT-NEW** (101069502) | HORIZON-CL2-2021-HERITAGE-02-01 | CENTRE FOR SOCIAL INNOVATION (CY) | **€3.00 Million** | CY, FR, IT, EL, SE, HU, ES |

### Key Details on ARGUS (101132308)

**Objective**: ARGUS directly addresses the challenges of monitoring remote built heritage assets through preventive preservation. It develops a **novel built heritage digital twin model** to support multi-scale/modal data, integrating portable measurements systems for non-destructive physical and chemical monitoring based on miniaturized sensors. This directly aligns with your project's focus on Digital Twinning and Predictive Maintenance.

**Partners**: The consortium includes 13 partners from 6 countries, including academic and industrial entities (e.g., SMEs specializing in sensors and software) essential for the technology demonstration aspect.

***

## Resources and Next Steps

To move forward with your proposal, focus on refining the **Implementation** section using the consortium patterns from these successful projects (e.g., the need for IT/Sensor SMEs, HES for research, and public bodies/museums for participatory elements).

🎯 **Getting Started with Horizon Europe:**
• Register on [EU Funding & Tenders Portal](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home)
• Review the specific [Cluster 2 Work Programmes](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents;programCode=HORIZON) (for Heritage topics) and [Cluster 4 Work Programmes](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents;programCode=HORIZON) (for Digital Twin technologies)
• Search the [Call Calendar](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/calls-calendar) for specific 2026 topics using keywords like 'heritage digital twin' and 'predictive maintenance'.
• Find full project details and partner lists on the [CORDIS database](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101132308) using the Grant Agreement IDs provided.
